Last Friday, Leo and Mia went to the green hill. Leo wrote about the day in the diary. Leo borrowed a book about music from the gym. Also, the gorilla family played in the shade.

The green hill is one of the best places in the city. Leo thinks music is interesting but a little difficult. The weather was snowy that day. Best of all, he collected sporting magazines as a teenager.
They took many photos at the camping site. Mia's birthday is in August. There are always many people at the camping site. In fact, the car needs more petrol.
Leo is going to travel to Toronto in August. Mia is interested in drawing. Life is full of small surprises.
